answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The island lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zephyr is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, diluted when peers disagree, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
